question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom / Phrase.

To pull somebody's leg
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"To pull somebody's leg"** means to tease or make fun of someone in a playful manner. (किसी का मजाक बनाना)

 
 
• **Example:** He said he saw a UFO, but I think he was just** pulling my leg.**
 
 
 
• **"To make fun of somebody"** refers to teasing or joking about someone, usually in a light-hearted way. (किसी का मजाक उड़ाना)
 
 
• **Example:** They were **making fun of him** because he wore mismatched socks.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **"To pull somebody's leg"** is **"To make fun of somebody"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To bear your expenses** (आपके खर्चों को वहन करना): To take responsibility for paying for something.

 
 
• **Example:** He offered to bear all the expenses for the trip.
 
 
 
• **To bring no harm** (कोई नुकसान न पहुंचाना): To ensure that no damage or injury is caused.
 
 
• **Example:** The medicine will bring no harm if taken as prescribed.
 
 
 
• **To refrain someone from working** (किसी को काम करने से रोकना): To prevent someone from doing their work.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager refrained him from working on the project due to his health issues.
 
 

3d:T5d7,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
